game.rules:
1. Exploits and other external software that could be used to gain an unfair advantage are not allowed in runs. The most prominent example of this would be wallhop macros, but anything that has to be downloaded and can give you an advantage in runs will not be allowed.
2. A run is timed based on what the in-game timer says on the first frame it becomes clear that you have touched the win pad of the tower (or, in cases of Coil/Event Items runs on soul crushing towers, the barrier around the win pad). If there is no clear evidence that you touched the win pad in the run (e.g. win/kick message), your run will likely be rejected.
3. When you're entering in your time while submitting your run, note that the "In-game time" section is the only one that you need to fill out. The other one doesn't matter.
4. Record the full run from **start to finish**. If you have some failed attempts in your video submission, please include a timestamp in the description of the run or set up the video link to skip to your winning attempt. (this can be done by adding "&t=?m?s" to the end of the YouTube video link)
5. If you get kicked by the anti-cheat, you are still able to submit the run.
6. Make sure that your timer is toggled on and visible for the entire run. This is so your run can be ... Timed ...
7. It is recommended that you show your FPS for the entire speedrun. You can do this by turning on "Display Performance Stats" in JToH's settings. (Disclaimer: This is NOT referring to the "Performance Stats" option in the Roblox menu. It's referring to the settings in JToH's menu that you can find on the left side of the screen when in-game.)

categories.name: Glitches [LEGACY]
categories.rules:
1. A run is timed based on what the in-game timer says on the first frame the player is seen touching the win pad of the tower.

2. You can fill in both the Time and In-game time, but the only one that is necessary is the In-game time.

3. Don't exploit in your runs. If you submit a run that breaks this rule I really don't know what you were even thinking here.

4. Glitches are allowed, with the exception of only 2 glitches: Item clipping (see rule 7) and the Canister Mode glitch. The latter has been banned because you need to have a lower-end PC to pull it off, and if someone does not have a lower-end PC, they would have to pay for one, which is inherently unfair.

5. There must be clear evidence of you having touched the win pad in your run. If there is not evidence and it is not **CLEAR**, your run will be rejected.

6. If you get kicked by the anti-cheat, you are still able to submit the run.

7. No items are allowed. This is because to get items, players have to have been in the community long enough to play some of the events and get the items from them, or they have to pay Robux for the item. This creates an unfair advantage for players who are unable to do either of those things, which is why items are banned.

8. Read the game rules. Anything that written there applies here and vice versa.

games.name: Eternal Towers of Hell
games.rules:
1. Exploits and other external software that could be used to gain an unfair advantage are not allowed in runs. The most prominent example of this would be wallhop macros, but anything that has to be downloaded and can give you an advantage in runs will not be allowed.
2. A run is timed based on what the in-game timer says on the first frame it becomes clear that you have touched the win pad of the tower (or, in cases of Coil/Event Items runs on soul crushing towers, the barrier around the win pad). If there is no clear evidence that you touched the win pad in the run (e.g. win/kick message), your run will likely be rejected.
3. When you're entering in your time while submitting your run, note that the "In-game time" section is the only one that you need to fill out. The other one doesn't matter.
4. Record the full run from **start to finish**. If you have some failed attempts in your video submission, please include a timestamp in the description of the run or set up the video link to skip to your winning attempt. (this can be done by adding "&t=?m?s" to the end of the YouTube video link)
5. If you get kicked by the anti-cheat, you are still able to submit the run.
6. Make sure that your timer is toggled on and visible for the entire run. This is so your run can be ... Timed ...
7. It is recommended that you show your FPS for the entire speedrun. You can do this by turning on "Display Performance Stats" in JToH's settings. (Disclaimer: This is NOT referring to the "Performance Stats" option in the Roblox menu. It's referring to the settings in JToH's menu that you can find on the left side of the screen when in-game.)
